about: Translation units of the game program recovered by tools/lbptu.py: each unit's first and last function start, its function count, and the evidence for its two ends (ctors: the unit's static constructor, its last function, listed in .ctors; region: the limit of the game region). A unit may hold several of the original files (one without static initialisers has no marker), never part of one. See that tool's docstring.
